ForwardObservers.description: Targets an enemy unit within range {[range]} that does not have a <style="Debuff_Markerlight">Markerlight</style>. The target receives a <style="Debuff_Markerlight">Markerlight</style> for {[nrOfRounds]} rounds. The <style="Faction_Tau">Stealth Battlesuit</style> then receives <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgPctReduction]}% Damage</style> from ranged attacks for {[nrOfRounds_2]} round.
